text: Isaac is the child of the covenant, the one through whom the nations are to be blessed; and the writer, having recalled that earlier promise, makes of it a test. Much depends on one word. Abraham says _hineni_, "here I am," three times, to God, to Isaac, to the angel, and on each occasion the word means something different from what it meant before, and costs him more than it did. The last of the three is spoken to the angel.
